integrity.mathematical_scope: proved all-degree rank and degree-six image constraints subject to self-contained code and analytic argument

scientific_limitations: Fixed uniformly truncated tetrahedral orbit of twelve points; only one homogeneous harmonic degree at a time.
The finite interval 7 through 575 is proved by an included exact-rational exhaustive checker; the infinite tail is controlled separately by a Laplace-integral estimate.
No sharp all-degree conditioning bounds, variable truncation, or mixed-degree sampling theorem are asserted.
Potential implicit equivalent in older tetrahedral harmonic invariant-theory tables is not excluded.
title: Harmonic interpolation on the truncated tetrahedron: a degree-six cycle obstruction
